args.content:
Hawaii Vacation Packing List
June 10-20, 2024

Essential Items:
- Travel documents (passport/ID, flight tickets, hotel reservations)
- Credit cards and cash
- Phone and charger
- Camera with extra batteries/memory cards
- Medications and first aid kit
- Travel insurance information

Clothing:
- Swimwear (at least 2 sets)
- Lightweight, breathable clothing
- Casual outfits for dinners and sightseeing
- Light jacket or sweater for cooler evenings
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Flip-flops or sandals
- Hat and sunglasses
- Rain jacket or small umbrella (for unexpected showers)

Beach & Water Activities:
- Beach towel
- Reef-safe sunscreen (SPF 30+)
- After-sun lotion or aloe vera
- Waterproof phone case
- Snorkeling gear (mask, snorkel, fins)
- Beach bag
- Water bottle

Hiking & Outdoor Activities:
- Sturdy hiking shoes
- Hiking socks
- Moisture-wicking shirts
- Quick-dry pants/shorts
- Daypack/backpack
- Insect repellent
- Sun protection (hat, sunglasses, sunscreen)

Activities-Specific Items:
- June 11 (Waikiki Beach): Beach games, cooler for drinks
- June 12 (Hanauma Bay snorkeling): Underwater camera, waterproof bag
- June 13 (Diamond Head hiking): Hiking poles, trail snacks, extra water
- June 14 (Pearl Harbor): Respectful attire, comfortable walking shoes
- June 15 (North Shore road trip): Car adapter for charging devices
- June 16 (Luau): Hawaiian shirt or dress (aloha attire)
- June 18 (Kailua Beach kayaking): Quick-dry clothing, waterproof watch
- June 19 (Shopping): Reusable shopping bags

Toiletries:
- Toothbrush and toothpaste
- Shampoo and conditioner
- Body wash
- Deodorant
- Hairbrush/comb
- Razor
- Makeup (if needed)
- Contact lenses and solution (if needed)

Electronics:
- Laptop/tablet (if needed for work)
- Headphones
- Power bank
- Universal power adapter
- Memory cards for camera

Miscellaneous:
- Books or e-reader for downtime
- Travel pillow for flights
- Snacks for travel days
- Reusable water bottle
- Small backpack for day trips
